name: Agent Relay / Relaycast
scope: Selected source, documentation and 21 isolated source-derived component checks; not a full application audit
compatibility: Relay SDK package reports 14.0.0 and depends on @relaycast/sdk ^8.0.7; separately cloned engine HEAD is not a verified matching deployment pair.

sources.observation: Model-neutral coding-agent toolkit, messaging, sessions and integration surfaces.
sources.limit: README features are not production verification; separate Relayfile/Flows implementations not audited.

sources.observation: Adapter outcomes map to ack, defer or failure; exceptions request retry; requires server delivery state.
sources.limit: Isolated synthetic adapters only; no delivery server executed.

sources.observation: Typed inputs and outputs, action events and optional policy hook.
sources.limit: Validation is not authorization; output validation happens after handler side effects.

sources.observation: Bounded event fan-in deduplicates cross-source copies; default 30-second window and 2,048 tracked keys.
sources.limit: Same-source repeats and expired-window repeats can pass; not business idempotency.

sources.observation: Empty canMessage/canSpawn lists skip allowlist checks despite displayed guidance describing none. Spawn count enforcement has a placeholder.
sources.limit: Reproduced on helper with fixture policy resolution; production call-site reachability not established.

sources.observation: Convenient temporary join links and probe setup; documents crossSessionInbound accept setting.
sources.limit: No installer or probe run. Evaluate disclosure, expiration, revocation and configuration restoration before adoption.

sources.observation: Workspace-authorized history search through Cloud; notes release prerequisites for sessions-only CLI support.
sources.limit: A repository feature is not proof that a published release supports it; no Cloud search performed.

sources.observation: Self-host Relaycast first; Relay CLI/broker handles agent sessions; hosted features still require Cloud.
sources.limit: Not a feature-parity or production deployment test.

sources.observation: Documents a single-process, single-tenant engine and in-memory sequencing, connection and background-work limitations.
sources.limit: Some generic idempotency statements differ from newer selected SQL-backed A2A paths; do not generalize across all subsystems.

sources.observation: Bearer authentication and workspace/agent/node contexts; observer scope checks.
sources.limit: Selected middleware review, not complete endpoint authorization audit.

sources.observation: Registered proxy path authenticates, scopes local targets and rejects external-proxy forwarding; message/send supported, proxy message/stream rejected. SQL-backed inbound fingerprint/idempotency logic is present.
sources.limit: Selected source only, not end-to-end A2A or specification conformance testing.

sources.observation: Bounded retries, claims/leases, target revalidation, retained source checks and state transitions.
sources.limit: No live failures injected; retention/retry window does not replace a long-lived business ledger.

sources.observation: Describes proof/revocation metadata carrier and verification against trusted issuer keys.
sources.limit: Metadata carrying a proof is not proof that every execution path verifies/enforces it.

sources.observation: Per-delivery acknowledgments avoid advancing a cumulative cursor past earlier pending work. Atomic transition guards and ownership checks are present.
sources.limit: Static selected-function review, not database race testing.

sources.observation: Documents CLI telemetry, identifiers and opt-out controls.
sources.limit: Self-host engine telemetry behavior does not imply every client has telemetry disabled; no runtime audit.

sources.observation: Selected transport code rejects credentialed HTTP and redirects.
sources.limit: Not a complete SSRF, DNS rebinding, egress or private-address audit.

limitations: No Cloud account, installer, probe or real agent messages used
No full upstream test suite, live federation, server runtime, load or penetration test
No commercial pricing or measured SupaBiz performance established
